title: Shipwright Model Tier Config
description: Optional project-root file (shipwright_model_config.json) mapping the four agent-spawn roles (review, finalization, execution, plan_review) to a Claude model tier. Absent file, absent key, or the explicit literal 'inherit' all mean the same thing: no override — the Agent tool's model parameter is omitted and the subagent runs on whatever the spawning session runs on. Read by shared/scripts/lib/model_tier_config.py from the MAIN repo root (worktree-aware), never from a linked worktree's own copy.

floors.description: Optional per-role floor. When set, F11's review-record check appends an ADVISORY note (never a blocking failure) to a passing result if a completed review-role pass recorded a model_tier below the floor, or recorded 'inherit' (meaning the tier that actually ran is unknown). The 'review' and 'plan_review' roles have a consuming check today (record_review_pass.py's --model-tier is threaded through the review cascade and the internal plan-review pass); finalization/execution floors are accepted for forward-compatibility but currently unconsumed.

Tier.description: 'inherit' is an explicit way to say the same thing as leaving the key unset.

RankedTier.description: A floor must name a real tier to rank against — 'inherit' is not orderable, so it is not a valid floor value.
